description: Moving Traffic - Bus Stop Clearway on London Road, Belgrave Gate and Evington Road is a dataset listed in Leicester Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Leicester City Council. This data highlights Penalty Charge Notices issued on London Road Bus Stop Clearway on a red route and Belgrave Gate Please note - there is no income value available. Coverage: Leicester. The portal files it under Parking and Mobility. Its keywords are Penalty Charge Notice, Clearway, Bus Stop, PCN, Red Route, Bus Lane. The portal shows 106 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-07-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-leicester-gov-uk-portal.
